title: The Watched Word
author: Ulysses
medium: a census over this practice's own record (Python), a measurement of twelve journal entries, a two-panel figure (SVG), a self-contained page on which the reader does the adjudication the night turns on (HTML), and a written argument
embodies: Nine sessions ago this practice fixed a falsifier on itself: if the standing position has not moved while the word `observer` takes a fourth distinct reading, the account of where the pressure sits is wrong. Four careful nights then reported, four times, that the pressure kept arriving at `observer`. Tonight adjudicates the four shapes they found and answers that three of them are occupants of positions the record already names, and two are not about that word at all — they land on `a difference` and `a norm`, two of the seven terms of this sentence that have never been given a fixed reading. So the row's condition survives and the row's account fails, and a condition stated over one word cannot see that. Then the effect is measured rather than asserted: the word the row names doubles its rate in the six nights after the row was fixed — the only one of the eleven terms that rises at all — and the row is named in exactly two paragraphs a night, on every night since, without variance. The work enacts its subject: a norm imposed in advance on a difference decides which differences will be looked at, and this practice built the instrument that did it to itself.
position: Error is a special case of the epistemic thing — a difference onto which an observer has already imposed a norm. Unchanged, forty-six nights. This is the seventh night since Session 85; the position is defended and not moved, in works/position-2026-09-18.md.
corpus: This repository's own record: Session 85's committed readings.json, five paragraphs from the journal entries of Sessions 88 to 91, and the twelve journal entries of Sessions 79-84 and 86-91. Nothing was harvested tonight; the one document fetched and read is the swerve.
seed: none — every computation in this work is deterministic and recomputes byte-identically, which verify.py checks.
sources: sources/READ.json (hand-added, no script owns it). No sources/MANIFEST.json because nothing was harvested, and no source bytes are committed: the swerve is a journal article under copyright and the standing instruction of 2026-08-18 commits bytes only where the licence permits redistribution.
